issue_context.title: BYPASS_HOST_LOOP is ignored if a custom module is not called by FQCN
issue_context.body:
### SUMMARY
If a custom module imported from a collection is invoked using an unqualified name (thanks to the `collections` keyword), then **BYPASS_HOST_LOOP** attribute in its implementation is ignored.

##### ISSUE TYPE
- Bug Report

##### COMPONENT NAME
collections

##### ANSIBLE VERSION
```
ansible 2.9.11
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/tomasz/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /usr/local/lib/python3.6/dist-packages/ansible
  executable location = /usr/local/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.6.9 (default, Jul 17 2020, 12:50:27) [GCC 8.4.0]
```
also tried:
```
ansible 2.10.2
  config file = /etc/ansible/ansible.cfg
  configured module search path = ['/home/tomasz/.ansible/plugins/modules', '/usr/share/ansible/plugins/modules']
  ansible python module location = /mnt/c/Workspace/automation/ansible2-10/ansible-2.10/lib/python3.6/site-packages/ansible
  executable location = /mnt/c/Workspace/automation/ansible2-10/ansible-2.10/bin/ansible
  python version = 3.6.9 (default, Jul 17 2020, 12:50:27) [GCC 8.4.0]
```

##### CONFIGURATION
`ansible-config dump --only-changed` gives no output

##### OS / ENVIRONMENT
WSL (Ubuntu-18.04)

##### STEPS TO REPRODUCE
Minimal action plugin (`myaction.py`):
```python
from ansible.plugins.action import ActionBase


class ActionModule(ActionBase):

    BYPASS_HOST_LOOP = True

    def run(self, tmp=None, task_vars=None):
        result = super(ActionModule, self).run(tmp, task_vars)
        del tmp  # tmp no longer has any effect
        return result
```

Folder structure:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15631478/95601757-348b3100-0a54-11eb-9453-011d0e7bf230.png)

Minimal playbook (`myplaybook.yml`)
```yaml
- hosts: host1,host2
  gather_facts: false
  collections:
    - my.collection
  tasks:
    - myaction:
```

Command:
```
ansible-playbook -i host1,host2 myplaybook.yml
```

##### EXPECTED RESULTS
Should run only against one host.
```
PLAY [host1,host2] ****************************************************************************************************

TASK [myaction] *******************************************************************************************************
ok: [host1]

PLAY RECAP ************************************************************************************************************
host1                      : ok=1    changed=0    unreachable=0    failed=0    skipped=0    rescued=0    ignored=0   
```

##### ACTUAL RESULTS
Runs against both hosts
```
PLAY [host1,host2] ****************************************************************************************************

TASK [myaction] *******************************************************************************************************
ok: [host1]
ok: [host2]

PLAY RECAP ************************************************************************************************************
host1                      : ok=1    changed=0    unreachable=0    failed=0    skipped=0    rescued=0    ignored=0   
host2                      : ok=1    changed=0    unreachable=0    failed=0    skipped=0    rescued=0    ignored=0   
```

It works if FQCN is used.
